latestVersion.changelog:
Whisk AI Image Remixer 1.0.0

- Initial release of Whisk AI, a tool for remixed image generation using Google’s Imagen backend.
- Enables creative blending of up to three input images (subject, scene, style) and text prompts for new AI-generated visuals.
- Automated credential setup with anonymous token and session management (includes 100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Supports upload, credits check, session state, and export to multiple formats (jpg, png, gif, mp4, etc).
- Robust error handling and clear user feedback for setup, session state, and common API issues.
